text:
Sam: Drafted the changelog entry for the latest inference rollout: KV/prefix cache improvements + canary rollout UI for Dedicated. Need quick sweep on: known issues, SDK snippets (py/js), and the migration note for Private.

Rita: Share the link pls?

Sam: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/draft-infer-optimizations (still WIP).

Vik: I'll check the Python snippet. Reminder: streaming example should show `stream=true` + `cache_prefetch=true` in the options.

Marcos: I found one broken anchor in the dedicated console section (screenshot#canary-config -> now screenshot#canary-settings). Fixing that.

Soojin: For Private customers: add a short migration note about config keys renaming (`kv_cache.enabled` -> `cache.kv_enabled`) and a quick rollback command if prefix misses occur.

Sam: Good call. Also add a callout about tokenization mismatches with some 4-bit quantized kernels (small % of off-by-one tokens) and link to eval details.

Rita: Draft Python snippet: ```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="...")
resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood-fast-1",
  input="Explain the change",
  stream=True,
  options={"cache_prefetch": True, "batch": {"max_tokens": 512}}
)
for chunk in resp.stream():
  print(chunk.text)
```
I'll mirror for JS after review.

Vik: Minor nit: `options` key is `client.options` in our SDK v0.9. Update shown API to `generate(..., options=...)` is ok but add version note.

Marcos: After I update anchors, can someone run an anchor/redirect sweep? Anna from SEO does that daily but she might be AFK. @docs-bot can we queue a linkcheck?

docs-bot: Linkcheck queued for 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z. Snippet linter queued as well.

Soojin: I'll write the migration blurb and the rollback example (one-liners for ops). Also adding the Private note about KMS key rotation compatibility.

Sam: Two final asks before merge: 1) add a short metric in the blurb like "up to 25% per-route token cost savings" (we can cite internal benchmark), 2) include a one-liner "how to opt-out" for customers who want legacy behavior.

Rita: I'll add the opt-out flag example: `cache.kv_enabled=false` in the deployment spec.

Vik: Once docs-bot finishes linting, can we aim to merge by EOD? If blockers, tag @Sam or @Rita.

Sam: Thanks all. I'll flip to "ready for review" after anchor fixes and snippets updated. :thumbsup:
